title: fix(release): extend ClawHub read recovery window
body:
## Summary

- add one bounded 30-second retry after the existing 1s/3s/10s ClawHub read backoff
- cover recovery after four consecutive transient HTTP 500 responses

## Release impact

The 2026.11.1-beta.1 qualification has repeatedly failed before child dispatch on different ClawHub packages even after the existing bounded retries. Recent failures include `@openclaw/byteplus-provider`, `@openclaw/exa-plugin`, and `@openclaw/fish-audio-speech`; each public endpoint recovered shortly afterward. This preserves the existing retry classifications and 60-second Retry-After ceiling while using available admission headroom to survive a longer transient outage.

## Validation

- `pnpm exec oxfmt --check src/infra/clawhub-retry.ts src/infra/clawhub-client.test.ts`
- `git diff --check`
- focused Vitest was attempted but the shared dependency install cannot resolve `@solidjs/vite-plugin`; exact-head CI will run the changed test owner
